searchText: Mainnet is 13 seconds > Mainnet is 13 seconds <@!273808422753796097> Ok, when everything works well i will reset the testnet and set a block period of 13 seconds. btw ideally the block period would be a poisson distribution As that's what it is IRL and we do need to test 1559-driven and block time-driven variance in combination BTW I feel like "1559" is bad branding increasingly Anyone have ideas for a better name? My bland alternative is "fee market reform" "burn gas" gas burner > btw ideally the block period would be a poisson distribution <@273808422753796097> Do you still have that script somewhere you used for predicting the ICE age? The maths could be ported over time simulate block times pretty easy. I do not, that was lost with an old laptop Shoot Oh, simulating a poisson distribution is easy I seem to have lost it as well 🤷‍♀️ it is omen Basically, have a formal "block time" of 2.5 sec, but add a rule that based on some hash formula, a random 80% of slots are invalid It's not *exactly* poisson, but it's within a couple percent of poisson and it's really easy to implement And you can push it to be almost exactly poisson with a 1 sec block time and 12/13 invalid probability > Anyone have ideas for a better name? <@273808422753796097> I’ll start some brainstorming. The number is pretty sticky atm, but I could see another name along with the testnet taking over. 1. fee market reform 2. automated fee stabilization 3. in-protocol gas market Elastic block mechanism In-protocol elastic fee burning market mechanism 🤔 I have liked TrustlessState’s description using the parallel of a block time adjustment mechanism. - Congestion based fee market mechanism
